description:
A free Windows website editor with visual editing and editable source.

Webbit is a free Windows website editor by Ravitz Computers, created as a fun side project with help from AI.
Edit pages visually alongside ordinary HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP files. Import sites and assets, use blocks and an optional contextual ribbon, and preview desktop, tablet and phone layouts.
Core editing works locally without an account, subscription or required cloud or AI service. Optional integrations may have their own costs.
This is Beta 1. See the project status for verified behavior and remaining limitations. Vinny and Ravitz branding retain their proprietary rights.
